plain_english: What true, what untrue, little-much, eternal, not eternal, what Māyā-stained, what self-pure — in the consciousness-mirror shines. That all, from own-grasping-consciousness-rise, form-light-natured, having known — own-experience-risen glory: Lordhood — worship.
sanskrit_cite: yat satyaṃ yad asatyam alpabahulaṃ nityaṃ na nityaṃ ca yat māyāmalinaṃ yad ātmavimalaṃ | ciddarpaṇe rājate tat sarvaṃ svavimarśasaṃvidudayād rūpaprakāśātmakaṃ jñātvā svānubhavādhirūḍha mahimā viśveśvaratvaṃ bhaja
